projects.title: ReturnTrail
projects.description: Connect disputed return-pickup claims to their original sources. Compare evidence, inspect graph paths and keep follow-ups tied to the context they reviewed.
projects.role: Full-stack development with Ajeet Gadekar. Both of us contributed across the frontend and backend.
projects.decision: A resolved task retains the sources it reviewed. New evidence can require a fresh follow-up instead of silently inheriting an earlier explanation.
projects.lesson: The agent could answer before using all required tools. Backend-enforced tool order and regression checks made the investigation sequence explicit.
projects.boundary: Fictional practice cases. Recorded claims and manual explanations do not independently establish fault.

projects.title: OnceTold
projects.description: Recall relevant customer history when a new support conversation begins, then write resolutions back to a customer-scoped Cognee memory graph.
projects.role: Solo build: the application, Java-to-FastAPI memory integration, interface and deployment work.
projects.decision: A loopback-only FastAPI bridge connects Java to Cognee. Authenticated ticket access determines whose memory is recalled; resolutions feed the next conversation.
projects.lesson: Cloud memory needed a bounded longer recall timeout. Render now uses dedicated Neon PostgreSQL so application records survive redeploys.
projects.boundary: Fictional demo data only. Agent registration is open. Free hosting can sleep and AI quotas apply; old Railway records were not imported.

projects.title: Contract Analyzer
projects.description: Compare supported payment terms in an Agreement and Statement of Work, inspect source quotes and keep local AI suggestions separate from rule-based review.
projects.role: Built the document-review workflow, supported payment-term comparison and source-checked AI candidate handling for an academic project.
projects.decision: AI candidates are displayed only after their days and unit match the supporting source quote. Suggestions do not automatically alter the rule verdict.
projects.lesson: Scanned and mixed PDFs need explicit OCR, page and upload limits. Exact source wording and legal interpretation are different questions.
projects.boundary: A focused payment-term prototype, not comprehensive legal review or legal advice. Inspect original documents and verify OCR text.

projects.title: SpiderSense
projects.description: Collect competitor-page snapshots, calculate structured changes and add AI-assisted explanations to pricing, hiring and company-news signals.
projects.role: Shared frontend and backend development with Yogesh Sanodiya. Both teammates contributed across the stack.
projects.decision: Calculate deterministic differences before asking AI to explain them. Archived snapshots preserve the before-and-after context behind an alert.
projects.lesson: A separate demo mode simulates changes for short presentations. The repository distinguishes this from real Bright Data acquisition.
projects.boundary: A team hackathon prototype. Simulated demo scenarios are not observed market events.
